title: ecb / ecb rate decision / inflation | Economic Commentary | Economic Bulletin Issue 2, 2026
summary: The ECB Governing Council kept interest rates unchanged at its 19 March 2026 meeting, citing significant uncertainty from the war in the Middle East creating upside inflation risks and downside growth risks. ECB staff revised up their inflation projections to 2.6% for 2026 (vs prior path) and revised down GDP growth to 0.9% for 2026, reflecting higher energy prices and disruptions to commodity markets, real incomes and confidence.
